description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Recharge-area polygons define wellhead-protection and potential groundwater-pollution areas. The native layer exposes polygon geometry and named attributes, including RANGE, SOLE_SOURCE_AQ, NAME, INSIDE. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for water quality studies. These regulatory/planning polygons do not provide groundwater concentrations, pumping rates or a calibrated aquifer model. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
